description:
UnitySVC runs the official drawDB image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. drawDB is a database schema editor that runs in the browser: you draw tables, fields and relationships on a canvas, generate the SQL for your database, import an existing schema from SQL, and export diagrams as images, PDF, JSON or DBML. The container only serves the application's static files.

Enroll in the base channel, then open the instance address and start designing. There is no sign-in and no server-side data: your diagrams are saved in your browser's own storage, so they stay on the computer and browser you used, and they are not part of the instance. Export or download a diagram to keep a copy. The optional sharing server from the drawDB project is not included. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream drawDB documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.
